caption: The drawing depicts a round, orange-brown ceramic plate with decorative motifs and an inscription. The composition shows the plate centered on a plain, light tan background with two pieces of beige tape visible on the right and lower right edges. The plate features a symmetrical floral design in the center, using colors such as yellow, green, black, and white. The design includes curling flower shapes and stylized leaves, with black and green elements accenting the central stem and branches. Two insect or bee-like figures in black, yellow, and green flanking the central motif are present towards the top. Surrounding the design along the rim of the plate is a band with a script inscription in a yellowish-beige color. Multiple concentric rings encircle the flat part of the plate, echoing the floral form and adding to the layered appearance. The artist’s signature, “E.H. Shellenberger 7/21,” is written in the lower right of the image just outside the plate.
title: Pennsylvania German Plate
